item.description:

item.description:
Address: Check event page for more details.
Toronto has incredible cafés hiding in plain sight. And most of us are moving too fast to actually enjoy them. Toronto Café Walk [Wellness Edition] is a slower, more intentional take on the usual format. Small group vibes, hand-picked café spots, and genuine human connection. But we start in the park first, so by the time we reach the café, you'll be fully present and relaxed for conversations.

item.title: Symphony in the City Opera Concert + Dinner by The Lake — Tue Aug 11, 5:45 PM
item.description:
Experience Toronto On **Tuesday August 11th,** **join our first Symphony in the City at the Palais Royale - We Care About Opera - performed by the Toronto Concert Orchestra (TCO).** Opera, distilled to its most thrilling, heart-stopping moments. **Opera Highlights** brings together the arias and songs everyone loves—*Nessun Dorma*, *O Sole Mio*, *Brindisi*, and more—in one unforgettable evening with the TCO at Palais Royale. Featuring radiant soprano **Natalya Gennadi**, powerhouse tenor **Romulo Delgado**, and NYC-based guest conductor **Mark Shapiro**, this concert delivers soaring melodies, emotional fireworks, and pure vocal brilliance. Whether you’re a lifelong opera lover or brand new to the genre, this program is designed to sweep you off your feet.
Big tunes. Big feelings. Big voices. Set in the elegant intimacy of Palais Royale, this is opera at its most accessible and exhilarating: the drama, the romance, the goosebumps—all the highlights, all in one night.

item.title: 🌿🚶‍♂️ YORK BELTLINE TRAIL EVENING WALK & PUB NIGHT 🍻🌿 — Thu Aug 13, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Try New Things in Toronto! # 🌿🚶‍♂️ YORK BELTLINE TRAIL EVENING WALK & PUB NIGHT 🍻🌿
**A Hidden Urban Trail, Easy Walking & A Relaxing Summer Evening**
Looking for an easy way to get outside after work?
Join us for a summer evening walk along the York Beltline Trail, one of Toronto's hidden green corridors.
Built on the route of the historic Belt Line Railway, this peaceful trail offers a surprising escape from the city, with mature trees, birdsong, and plenty of shade—all just steps from the subway. This is an easy, mostly flat walk with no major hills, making it perfect for anyone who wants to stretch their legs, enjoy some fresh air, and meet new people.
After our walk, we'll head over to **The Bull: A Firkin Pub** for dinner and a chance to relax, chat, and get to know one another. After all, the walk is just the beginning—the conversations afterward are where friendships often start.

item.title: Leader's Choice: Maple Bakery on trails from Finch — Sat Aug 15, 9:30 AM
item.description:
Elena's route to the bakery, with trails and paths. The ride starts out on the Finch Hydro Corridor path, then takes Hidden Trail in G Ross Lord Park. After crossing Steeles Ave, you ride on Bartley Smith Greenway, following the Don River West Branch, all the way north to Langstaff Road. Add in a few streets and some more of the Greenway, and you are close to the bakery. The return trip from the bakery to Finch Station is closer to the customary route on streets. item.description:
Try New Things in Toronto! # 🌿🚶‍♂️ NEW! EAST DON TRAIL ADVENTURE 🍪🥾
**Toronto's Newest Ravine Trail, Riverside Views & Fresh-Baked Cookies**
Have you walked Toronto's newest trail yet?
Join us as we explore the recently completed **East Don Trail**—one of the city's newest and most exciting additions to Toronto's incredible ravine system. Connecting communities that were once separated, this beautiful trail follows the East Don River through peaceful forests, wetlands, and scenic valley landscapes that many Torontonians have never experienced.
If you've done the Lower Don Trail, this is a completely different experience. Think quieter trails, beautiful river views, brand-new pathways, and the feeling of discovering somewhere new.
